slots.frame: border-[length:var(--bw-surface)] border-base-300 rounded-surface overflow-hidden bg-base-200 shadow-surface-rest
slots.th: table-cell px-row-px py-row-py text-left align-middle font-mono text-ctl-2xs font-bold tracking-column-header uppercase text-base-content/62 border-b-[length:var(--bw-separator)] border-base-300 outline-none focus:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_var(--focus-width)_var(--focus-ring)]
slots.pager: flex justify-end border-t-[length:var(--bw-separator)] border-base-300 px-row-px py-row-py
slots.row: table-row border-t-[length:var(--bw-separator)] border-base-300 transition-[background] duration-[var(--dur-hover)] ease-out
slots.td: table-cell px-row-px py-row-py text-left align-middle text-ctl font-body text-base-content/82 outline-none focus:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_var(--focus-width)_var(--focus-ring)]
slots.tdMono: table-cell px-row-px py-row-py text-left align-middle text-ctl font-mono tabular-nums text-secondary outline-none focus:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_var(--focus-width)_var(--focus-ring)]
slots.empty: px-4 py-8 text-center align-middle text-ctl text-base-content/62
slots.card: flex flex-col gap-stack bg-base-200 border-[length:var(--bw-surface)] border-base-300 rounded-surface p-row-px shadow-surface-rest
slots.cardLabel: font-mono text-ctl-2xs font-bold tracking-column-header uppercase text-base-content/62
slots.cardValueMono: min-w-0 text-right text-ctl font-mono tabular-nums text-secondary
slots.cardBlock: w-full flex justify-end gap-2 border-t-[length:var(--bw-separator)] border-base-300 pt-2
